description: Ask one of the agents the month's plan runs for one extra run now, before its turn comes: worth it when fresh findings would change what Marsell makes or answers in the next days and its last run is too old for that (the day before a premiere or a launch, to read where viewers or buyers are talking about it; news in the business's field; a rival's move). Not worth it when nothing this week depends on it. It spends from that agent's own tokens for the month and stops at its budget. Only an agent that is on; while one early run of it waits or runs, a second ask is refused. On now: search (AI answer checks, once a day); discovery (Discovery, once a day); listening (Listening, every hour); creators (Creator search, once a week); press (Press and directories, once a day); watch (Site checks, every hour); videos (Video readings, once a day). Returns the agent started and the tokens it had left this month before this run; what it finds shows where its work always shows (agent_open). It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

agent.description: The agent, by its id from the list of those on now.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: One plain sentence the owner reads in the activity feed, in the business's terms ("Your premiere is tomorrow, so it reads where viewers are talking about it.").
